request: In the watchlist, show movies I haven't watched yet before the ones I've watched.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
requests.reason: The new unwatched-first ordering moves Movie 1's row to the end once it becomes watched, so the test's re-lookup of items()[0]'s checkbox now resolved to Movie 2's unchecked checkbox and the assertion could not hold. Updated the assertion to locate Movie 1's row by title, preserving the original intent exactly: the clicked checkbox becomes checked, watchedCount becomes 1, and the subtitle shows '1 of 2 watched'.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when blank space on the row is clicked
requests.reason: Same unavoidable side effect of the mandated reordering: after the row click toggles Movie 1 to watched, its row is no longer the first item, so checkbox() resolved to Movie 2's checkbox. Updated to find Movie 1's row by title and assert its checkbox is checked, which still tests the original behaviour (clicking blank space on a row toggles watched).
